$comment: Daily puzzles dealt by engines since replaced, frozen so they never change. Every later day is dealt live, by the engine of the last segment (GENERATOR_VERSION). Each line in "days" is a date, the engine version that dealt it and its encodeGivens codes in "tiers" order. Do not edit by hand: npm run dailies:freeze and npm run dailies:switch maintain it (README, "Changing the engine").
